en.title: Farm Credit Administration: 2 references with a wrong U.S. Code section or act name
en.summary: In the CFR chapters assigned to the Farm Credit Administration, 2 references in 2 sections cite the U.S. Code or an act with an error: 2 name an act differently from the U.S. Code. Each reference was compared with release point 119-134 of the U.S. Code published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
en.impact: A reader who follows these references reaches a different section or looks for an act under a name the U.S. Code does not use. No effect on a decision or an amount has been established.
en.correction: The agency decides how to correct each reference. Where the U.S. Code shows the section or the name intended, the evidence below gives it.
